title: Yoisaki Kanade — Ceremony In The Classroom〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everything up to the pre-chorus sounds much better now. Now I just need to work on tying the chorus and interlude together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, anyone there?
I'm back after working my tush off at work.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Welcome back.
Did you have an early shift today?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, K! Yeah, I did!
There was a movie I wanted to see at night, so I asked someone to switch with me♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hi, K... Oh, Amia, you're here too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Enanan! All done with art class?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can't exactly log in from there, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, that reminds me.
I saw a really wholesome sight on my way home.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, pretty sure I spotted some first-years from one of the other schools. They looked like they hadn't quite figured out how they wanted to wear their uniforms yet.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <They seemed so excited about their new lives and situations that they couldn't really contain themselves.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Really...? It's already that time of year...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Even though not too long ago, the real possibility of being held back had Mizuki panicking.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, I wasn't the only one.
Li'l Bro was in the same situation.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, attendance was my problem. I wasn't in trouble for failing a bunch of tests.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I have nothing to do with Akito's grades.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What?! You're so cold!
Even though you've been asking him to be your human alarm clock anytime you have something going on.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, speaking of alarms...
Amia, don't forget to set yours so that you actually get up in the morning tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Kamiyama High's having theirs tomorrow...?
Are the night school students also going?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, but ours is on the same day.
It'll take place when we normally have classes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, K, what about your correspondence school? Do they hold opening ceremonies and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, mine does. We're supposed to attend those sorts of ceremonies and events when we can.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I didn't know that.
When is your school's?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Uhh... Good question...
They should be sending me an email, but...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, they sent me one about the opening ceremony three weeks ago... When is it...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, talk about cutting it close! It's a good thing you realized!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <W-Wow. So, what am I going to need...? Wait, clothes. They probably won't let me go in sweats...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Try to calm down, K! You still have time! Start by reading through the whole email!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Phew...
Thank goodness. I should be okay as long as I start preparing for it now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Man, I thought you were done for when you said it was tomorrow♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you both very much.
I probably would've missed it if we didn't have this conversation.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! Us being so chatty ended up saving your skin.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, it doesn't seem all that unusual.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. We should tell Yuki about this when she gets here, and let her know that being talkative has its benefits.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I dunno. I feel like eighty percent of what we talk about is pretty meaningless.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(The opening ceremony...
I didn't think I'd be attending another school event.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They might be a good source of inspiration once in a while.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should set an alarm now since I'll probably forget between working and napping.)
